track: A Song with a Hole in It

cues.text: Here is a song but it's got a hole in it

I had hoped that I could make it perfect
cause I know you like for things to be perfect

Perfect like
But everything I tried just made the hole bigger
And soon there was nothing that did not fall into it
First it was my fingers and then it was my hands
And then it was my eyes opening in the dark of a hole
Deep down a song that hardly gets sung
Where I disappear until now
